ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a high-contrast distribution of high-intensity (white) speckles and distal patches, estimated ratio 85:15.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Widespread high-intensity white speckling across both lobes; contiguous white geometric patches localized on the distal tips (left and right edges).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle approximately 48 degrees with high vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations; prominent peaks visible along the distal segments of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve leading to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white circular clusters (barnacles) localized on the outer distal edges; numerous small, discrete circular white scars distributed across the central ventral region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) present on the left lobe and lower central fluke area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of large, high-relief barnacle colonies on the distal trailing edges; multiple circular and linear scars across the visible surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Characteristic 'starfield' pattern of dense white speckling against a black background; asymmetrical white trailing edge highlights.
